definitions.short: in a good sense, trust ; in a bad one, silliness
definitions.full: H3690. kislah כִּסְלָה noun feminine (Gie ZAW i, 1881, 304 ). 1 stupidity Psa 85:9 (but read ᵐ5 לֹה לִבָּם Bae Che). 2 confidence , suffix כִּסְלָתֶ֑ךָ Job 4:6 .
